## 18.1 Production Moran's I with Both Inference Methods

```julia
# === src/autocorr/global.jl ===
"""
moran(values, w; method=:permutation, permutations=999, alternative=:two_tailed)
```

Compute Global Moran's I statistic for spatial autocorrelation.

```julia
# Arguments
- `values`:       Variable to test for spatial autocorrelation
- `w`:            SpatialWeights object
- `method`:       `:permutation` (nonparametric) or `:analytical` (normal approx)
- `permutations`: Number of Monte Carlo permutations (for :permutation method)
- `alternative`:  `:two_tailed`, `:greater` (positive SA), `:less` (negative SA)
# Returns
```

Named tuple with fields: I, expected_I, variance, z_score, p_value, method

```julia
# References
```

Moran, P.A.P. (1950). Notes on continuous stochastic phenomena.

Biometrika, 37(1-2), 17-23.

```julia
# Example
```julia
w = queen_weights(counties.geometry)
result = moran(counties.cvd_rate, w)
println(\"Moran's I = $(result.I), p = $(result.p_value)\")
```
"""
function moran(
values::AbstractVector{<:Real},
w::AbstractSpatialWeights;
method::Symbol        = :permutation,
permutations::Int     = 999,
alternative::Symbol   = :two_tailed,
rng::AbstractRNG      = Random.default_rng()
)
# Input validation — fail fast with informative messages
n = nobs(w)
length(values) == n ||
throw(DimensionMismatch(
"values has length $(length(values)), weights has $(n) units"))
any(isnan, values) &&
throw(ArgumentError("values contains NaN — remove missing before calling moran()"))
n > 1 || throw(ArgumentError("Need at least 2 observations"))
x = Float64.(values)
return _moran_impl(x, w, Val(method), permutations, Val(alternative), rng)
end
# ── Permutation-based inference ──────────────────────────────
function _moran_impl(
x::Vector{Float64},
w::AbstractSpatialWeights,
::Val{:permutation},
permutations::Int,
::Val{alt},
rng::AbstractRNG
) where {alt}
n     = nobs(w)
x̄     = mean(x)
z     = x .- x̄
denom = dot(z, z)
denom ≈ 0 && return MoranResult(0.0, -1/(n-1), 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, :permutation)
```

S0    = sum(w.W)

Wz    = w.W * z

I_obs = (n / S0) * dot(z, Wz) / denom

```julia
# Monte Carlo permutation distribution
```

I_perm = Vector{Float64}(undef, permutations)

x_perm = copy(x)

z_perm = similar(z)

```julia
@inbounds for k in 1:permutations
shuffle!(rng, x_perm)     # Random spatial reassignment
z_perm .= x_perm .- mean(x_perm)
d_perm  = dot(z_perm, z_perm)
```

Wz_perm = w.W * z_perm

I_perm[k] = (n / S0) * dot(z_perm, Wz_perm) / d_perm

```julia
end
```

E_I = mean(I_perm)

V_I = var(I_perm)

z_score = (I_obs - E_I) / sqrt(V_I)


## 18.2 Full LISA Implementation with Cluster Mapping

```julia
# One- or two-tailed empirical p-value
p_value = if alt == :two_tailed
mean(abs.(I_perm) .>= abs(I_obs))
elseif alt == :greater
mean(I_perm .>= I_obs)
else  # :less
mean(I_perm .<= I_obs)
end
# Add 1/permutations as continuity correction (Anselin convention)
p_corrected = min(1.0, p_value + 1.0/permutations)
return MoranResult(I=I_obs, expected_I=E_I, variance=V_I,
z_score=z_score, p_value=p_corrected,
method=:permutation)
end
# === src/autocorr/local.jl ===
"""
moran_local(values, w; permutations=999, alpha=0.05)
```

Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA) — Anselin (1995).

Returns location-specific Moran statistics and cluster classifications.

```julia
# Returns LISAResult with fields:
- `I_local`:      n-vector of local Moran statistics
- `p_values`:     n-vector of permutation p-values
- `cluster`:      n-vector of Symbols: :HH, :LL, :HL, :LH, :NS
- `z_scores`:     n-vector of standardized local I
- `significance`: threshold alpha used
# Cluster types:
- HH (High-High): high value surrounded by high neighbors → hot spot
- LL (Low-Low):   low value surrounded by low neighbors → cold spot
- HL (High-Low):  high value surrounded by low neighbors → outlier
- LH (Low-High):  low value surrounded by high neighbors → outlier
- NS:             not statistically significant at alpha
"""
function moran_local(
values::AbstractVector{<:Real},
w::AbstractSpatialWeights;
permutations::Int   = 999,
alpha::Float64      = 0.05,
rng::AbstractRNG    = Random.default_rng()
)
n = nobs(w)
length(values) == n ||
throw(DimensionMismatch("values length $(length(values)) ≠ n=$(n)"))
x  = Float64.(values)
x̄  = mean(x)
z  = x .- x̄
m2 = dot(z, z) / n          # Variance of z (for standardization)
m2 ≈ 0 && return _constant_lisa(n, alpha)
# ── Observed local Moran statistics ──────────────────────
# I_i = (z_i / m2) * Σ_j w_ij * z_j
lag_z  = w.W * z             # Spatial lag of z
```

I_local = (z ./ m2) .* lag_z

```julia
# ── Permutation test: location-specific ──────────────────
# For each location i, we permute values at ALL OTHER locations
# keeping z_i fixed. This is the standard LISA permutation.
p_values = ones(Float64, n)
```

I_perm_i = Vector{Float64}(undef, permutations)

z_perm   = similar(z)

```julia
@inbounds for i in 1:n
zi_fixed = z[i]
for k in 1:permutations
# Permute all values except i
copyto!(z_perm, z)
# Swap z[i] to position 1 for efficient exclusion
other_idx = [j for j in 1:n if j != i]
shuffle!(rng, view(z_perm, other_idx))
# z_perm[i] stays as zi_fixed; neighbors get permuted
# Compute local lag for location i only
nbrs = neighbors(w, i)
nwts = neighbor_weights(w, i)
lag_i = dot(nwts, z_perm[nbrs])
```

I_perm_i[k] = (zi_fixed / m2) * lag_i

```julia
end
# Two-tailed empirical p-value for location i
p_values[i] = mean(abs.(I_perm_i) .>= abs(I_local[i]))
end
# ── Cluster classification ────────────────────────────────
cluster = fill(:NS, n)
lag_x   = w.W * x            # Spatial lag of original values
@inbounds for i in 1:n
p_values[i] < alpha || continue  # Skip non-significant
hi_val  = x[i]     >= x̄
hi_lag  = lag_x[i] >= x̄
cluster[i] = if hi_val && hi_lag;   :HH
elseif !hi_val && !hi_lag; :LL
elseif hi_val && !hi_lag;  :HL
else                        :LH
end
end
return LISAResult(
```

I_local   = I_local,

p_values  = p_values,

cluster   = cluster,

z_scores  = I_local ./ std(I_local),

significance = alpha

)

```julia
end
# ── Convenience: count clusters ───────────────────────────────
cluster_counts(r::LISAResult) = Dict(
:HH => count(==(:HH), r.cluster),
:LL => count(==(:LL), r.cluster),
:HL => count(==(:HL), r.cluster),
:LH => count(==(:LH), r.cluster),
:NS => count(==(:NS), r.cluster)
)
```
